tasks.ask: A story of 4 to 6 short sentences on a book theme, then five questions (2 recall, 2 understand, 1 apply), one mark each, with answers.
tasks.instruction_en: Read the short story aloud twice. Then ask the questions; the child answers aloud.
tasks.instruction_ur: مختصر کہانی دو بار بلند آواز سے پڑھیں، پھر سوال پوچھیں؛ بچہ زبانی جواب دے۔

tasks.ask: One topic a Grade 1 child knows (my family, my school, my favourite food), with three prompt questions.

rubric.en: Says three or more things about the topic
rubric.ur: موضوع پر تین یا زیادہ باتیں

rubric.en: Uses English words and short sentences

tasks.instruction_en: Ask the child to talk about the topic for about a minute. Prompt with the questions if they stop.
tasks.instruction_ur: بچے سے موضوع پر تقریباً ایک منٹ بات کرنے کو کہیں۔ رک جائے تو سوالوں سے مدد کریں۔

tasks.ask: Six simple book words (three-letter and sight words) printed large for the child to read.
tasks.instruction_en: Point to each word in turn. The child reads it aloud. One mark per word read right.
tasks.instruction_ur: ہر لفظ پر باری باری انگلی رکھیں۔ بچہ اسے بلند آواز سے پڑھے۔ ہر درست لفظ پر 1 نمبر۔

items.ask: Who went to the park with Pinky?
What did Pinky see on the ground?
Why did Pinky give the bird water and food?
items.answer: Because the bird was hurt and she wanted to help it.

items.ask: How did the bird feel at the end?
items.answer: Better, happy (it sang a sweet song).

items.ask: What would you do if you saw a hurt bird?
items.answer: Any kind answer, e.g. help it, give it water, tell a grown-up.

content.script: Pinky and Jojo went to the park. Pinky saw a small bird on the ground. The bird was hurt. Pinky gave the bird water and food. Jojo helped her. Soon the bird sang a sweet song.

items.ask: Topic: My family. Who lives in your home with you?
items.answer: Any answer naming family members, e.g. mother, father, brother, sister, Dadi.

items.ask: What do you like to do with your family?
items.answer: Any answer, e.g. play, eat together, go to the park.

items.ask: How do you help at home?
items.answer: Any answer, e.g. I help my mother, I put away my toys.

slots.prompt_rule: Six items, each one book object as picture: {kind:"object", name}. Put all six words, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item only. Answer: the word.
slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture and write its word from the box.

slots.prompt_rule: Five items of three or four letters out of order, e.g. "d b c". Answer: the ordered letters.
slots.instruction_en: Write the letters in ABC order.

slots.prompt_rule: Four items: a first letter and an ending (-at, -in, -an, -ig, -op) from the book, e.g. "c + at = ____". Answer: the word.
Five three- or four-letter book words with letters mixed, e.g. "t a c". Only one word can be made. Answer: the word.
slots.instruction_en: Put the letters in order to make a word.

slots.prompt_rule: Four items, each a book object as picture: {kind:"object", name} and its word with one letter blank, e.g. "b_g". Answer: the full word.
slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture and fill in the missing letter.

slots.prompt_rule: Four simple book words, e.g. "cat". Answer: one rhyming word; accept lists other real rhymes.
Nine book objects (animals, fruit, school things), each as picture: {kind:"object", name}. Stem: "What is this?". Answer: the word.
slots.instruction_en: Write the name of each picture.

slots.prompt_rule: Four items, each a child doing one action from the book (run, jump, read, eat, sleep, swim) as picture: {kind:"scene", describe}. Answer: the action word.
slots.instruction_en: What is the child doing? Write the action word.

slots.prompt_rule: Five short sentences from the book, each with one blank. Put the five answer words, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item. Scheme: K 2 for the right word.
slots.instruction_en: Fill in the blanks with words from the box.

slots.prompt_rule: Five items: a capital letter as the stem and four small letters as options (a, b, c, d). Answer: the matching small letter.
slots.instruction_en: Match the capital letter with its small letter.

slots.prompt_rule: Five book words with two letters missing, with a clue, e.g. "a fruit: m _ _ go". Answer: the word.
Five book objects as picture: {kind:"object", name}. Answer: "This is a <name>." Scheme: K 1 for the word, K 1 for the sentence with capital and full stop.
slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture and write "This is a ____."

slots.prompt_rule: Two greetings or polite words from the book (Good morning, Thank you, Sorry, Please), each a scene as picture: {kind:"scene", describe} of two children. Answer: the words. Scheme: K 2.
slots.instruction_en: What will they say? Write in the speech bubble.

slots.prompt_rule: Four short sentences written all in small letters, each needing one capital (start or a name). Answer: the corrected sentence.
slots.instruction_en: Rewrite the sentence with a capital letter.

slots.prompt_rule: Five short sentences with one blank; options exactly is, am, are. Answer: the right word.
